metadata.name: Fort Meadow
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A wide, gently rolling meadow made for Fort Wars: two flag bases 84 m apart on flat greens with room all round to build, a low ridge with two saddles across the middle (the build-phase barrier runs along it) and grassy knolls on the flanks for high ground. Grenade launchers at each base and rockets on the ridge for knocking the other side's fort down. Plays Capture the Flag and Team Deathmatch too.
